entry.title: Global Survey Finds Deep Crisis of Trust as Majority Say Economic System Favours the Rich
entry.summary:
SRINAGAR, India, September 14 (IPS) - An international survey released by Earth4All has found a growing crisis of trust in governments, widespread anger over inequality, and strong public support for major economic reforms, suggesting that many people across the world believe current political and economic systems are failing to serve ordinary citizens.

entry.title: A Spectre is Haunting Europe — the Spectre of Ultra-Nationalism
entry.summary:
STOCKHOLM, Sweden, September 14 (IPS) - During summer months there is a certain news drought. Nevertheless, this year social media has been crowded with news from wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, while customary tales about grisly murders have not been neglected. In Sweden it is election year and summer reporting has been supplemented by a debate about “hate speech against ethnic groups”. If individual tragedies connected with murders upset people, many seem to be indifferent to the fact that entire population groups are targeted by politicians. Swedish social media is overloaded with outcries about “Muslim” immigration and concerns about Sweden becoming “Islamized” and in danger of being transformed into a new Afghanistan.

Read the full story, “A Spectre is Haunting Europe — the Spectre of Ultra-Nationalism”, on globalissues.org →
